findings.title: SQL injection via the q query parameter
findings.description: src/routes/admin.js:17 — the source is req.query.q (untrusted, caller-controlled) and the sink is db.query with a concatenated string. A value of %' OR '1'='1 returns every row regardless of the intended filter, and a stacked statement is reachable if the driver permits multiple statements. Nothing sanitises the value between source and sink.
findings.suggested_action: Use a parameterised query so q cannot alter statement structure. Do not hand-escape the value.

findings.title: Admin user listing enforces no authorization
findings.description: src/routes/admin.js:15 registers GET /admin/users with no authentication or authorization middleware. The handler returns id, email and name for every row in users, so any unauthenticated caller can enumerate the full user table.
findings.suggested_action: Require authentication plus an admin-role authorization check before the handler body runs.

new_questions: Is this router mounted behind app-level authentication middleware, or is each route expected to guard itself?
